instruction: Denise has requested me to buy "Nintendo Switch Lite" on amazon for them as their card is currently blocked. Place the order and forward the confirmation email containing the receipt to them, and make a venmo request to them for the total cost of the order, with a description note, "Amazon Order".
notes: Denise's email is looked up through phone.search_contacts (she is a phone contact); the same email address is used both as the gmail forward recipient and the venmo request target. The order is modeled as a single order object whose paid_amount is a runtime amount object (order-total-amount); venmo-create-payment-request requires (known-amount) which only amazon.show_order provides, tying the request amount to the order total. Quantity 1 is passed explicitly to add_product_to_cart to satisfy the single-unit requirement. The confirmation email (and its receipt attachment / file_system records) is created automatically by place_order, so gmail-show-inbox-threads requires (order-placed) before the thread id can be known; gmail.show_thread then exposes the email id used by forward_email_from_thread (which produces the 'Fwd: Amazon Order Confirmation' email). Existing payment card and address are reused (no address changes). supervisor-complete-task takes the task records as non-API parameters so its precondition equals the goal conjunction; it is called without an answer since the task asks no question.
